Unknown opcode: show in debugger as unknown.
   - A disassemble(opcode) function returning a human-readable string (e.g. "LD V3, 0x1F", "DRW V0, V1, 5", "JP 0x200") used by the debugger panel.
   - Main loop: requestAnimationFrame; when running, execute N instructions per frame (N from the speed slider); timers tick at 60 Hz based on elapsed time; render canvas from pixel buffer each frame (use ImageData or fillRect per pixel — ImageData preferred); update debugger panel each frame.
   - Run/Pause/Step/Reset: Step executes exactly one instruction and updates debugger even when paused. Reset clears memory/registers/stack/display/timers, reloads font and the currently loaded ROM (keep the last loaded ROM bytes so reset re-loads it), sets PC=0x200.

  0x12,0x0A, 0xFF,0xFF, 0x20,0x70,0xF8,0x70,0x20
];
(The last 5 bytes starting at offset 0x38 are the sprite data 0x20,0x70,0xF8,0x70,0x20; the 0xFF,0xFF padding before it is harmless dead code never executed.)

4. Every visible control must work: all buttons, slider (live label update), file input, keypad highlights, debugger values. Add brief comments in the JS. Keep the code clean and organized: FONT set constant, Chip8 state object or class, loadRom(), reset(), step()/cycle(), disassemble(), render(), updateDebugger(), key handlers, main loop.

Write the complete file at the given path. It must be fully functional when opened directly in a browser via file:// — no network access needed."}
